title: The Long Road Home
synopsis: The lander ascends, docks with the waiting orbiting cabin, and the crew returns to Earth for a parachute-aided ocean splashdown and joyful homecoming.
continuity_state: Before: Lunar rover station is working; all six are safely at the lunar lander with the orbiting return cabin waiting overhead. After: All six return safely to Brook Road, with original town infrastructure unchanged. Scout, rover and science station remain on the Moon and transmit data; Jack records the whole path in his existing notebook.
